home.para.1: SOURCE ry is the community for Information and Communication Technology (ICT) students at Tampere University of Applied Sciences (TAMK), bringing together future ICT professionals, student life, and career opportunities. We foster a strong sense of community, build valuable networks, and connect students with companies across the industry.
home.para.2: Throughout the year, we organize a diverse range of events, from casual sauna evenings and our popular TiTeLAN events to company visits, expert talks, and networking events. We actively collaborate with Tamko, TIRO ry, other student organizations, and our corporate partners.
home.para.3: Membership is open to all TAMK students, regardless of their degree programme.
home.partners.title: Our partners
partners.partnership.para.1: SOURCE ry's goal is to bring students and companies closer together. Our corporate partnerships provide students with opportunities to explore companies, learn about the industry, and build valuable professional networks. For companies, partnering with SOURCE ry offers visibility among Information Technology students at Tampere University of Applied Sciences (TAMK) and a direct connection to future professionals in the field.
partners.partnership.para.2: We believe that successful collaboration should be flexible and mutually beneficial. Therefore, we tailor our partnerships to meet the needs and goals of each company. Below are some of the opportunities available.
partners.basic.para.1: SOURCE ry offers partner companies the opportunity to share job openings, internship positions, thesis opportunities, and other relevant announcements with our members in accordance with the partnership agreement.
partners.basic.list.1: Company logo displayed on the SOURCE ry website
partners.basic.list.2: A company presentation on the Partners page
partners.basic.list.3: Opportunities to communicate relevant news and opportunities to our members
partners.excursion.para.1: Company visits are among the most popular events organized by SOURCE ry. They provide students with a unique opportunity to explore a company's operations, work environment, technologies, and career opportunities.
partners.excursion.para.2: For companies, excursions are an excellent way to meet Information Technology students, showcase their workplace culture, and strengthen their employer brand among potential future employees.
partners.lecture.para.1: Guest lectures offer companies an opportunity to share professional expertise and practical industry insights with students.
partners.lecture.para.2: Students are particularly interested in learning about real-world projects, technologies, development practices, and current industry trends. SOURCE ry can assist in arranging suitable facilities at TAMK for these events.
partners.overalls.para.1: Advertising on student overalls is a traditional and highly visible way to reach students. SOURCE ry offers companies the opportunity to place their logo or advertisement on our student overalls.
partners.overalls.para.2: Advertising prices vary depending on the size and placement of the logo, ranging from €500 to €1,000.
partners.overalls.para.3: Revenue generated from overall advertisements is used to support student activities and help fund the procurement of student overalls.
partners.contact.para.1: Interested in collaborating with SOURCE ry?
partners.contact.para.2: We tailor our partnerships to match the objectives of each company. Contact us to discuss how your organization can connect with TAMK's Information Technology students and future industry professionals.
partners.futurice.para.1: Futurice is a pioneer in digital transformation. We help organizations leverage technology, creativity, and agile ways of working to transform their businesses, develop their services, and create sustainable competitive advantage.
partners.kaijakka.para.1: The best karaoke in Tampere every day of the week! Karaoke, nightclub, sauna, and terrace.
partners.kaijakka.para.2: Restaurant Kaijakka is a long-standing karaoke venue and a full-scale nightclub located in the heart of Tampere, on the waterfront of Laukontori Square. Kaijakka’s versatile facilities are ideal for a wide range of events, including celebrations, corporate functions, birthday parties, bachelor and bachelorette parties, and other private occasions.
partners.netum.para.1: Netum’s roots are firmly grounded in Finland and in high-quality technological expertise. We aim to be an enabler of change and responsible digital development for our customers, their most trusted digital partner, and the most desirable workplace in the industry.
partners.nokia.para.1: Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era, providing the critical network infrastructure the world relies on.
partners.nokia.para.2: Open yourself to start your career with Nokia. We’re looking for unique minds, and we hire around 500 trainees annually in Finland. Apply to our open positions via www.nokia.com/careers.
partners.reaktor.para.1: Reaktor is a Finnish globally operating technology company that designs, builds and sells software products and digital solutions that it considers pioneering.
partners.hene.para.1: Enjoy your journey with Siniset Bussit! Siniset Bussit is a transportation company based in Lempäälä, offering charter bus services with its own fleet and a positive, customer-focused attitude.
partners.toas.para.1: Different homes for different students, at one-fifth lower rents than on the private market. Explore our apartments and discover life with TOAS!
